related.title: POSIX pthread：條件變數與遺失喚醒
related.titleEn: POSIX pthreads: condition predicates and lost wakeups
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付兩種事件模型及不安全handler操作的替代方案；不宣稱此教學器重現所有OS排程。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver both event models and alternatives to unsafe handler work; do not claim to reproduce every OS scheduling behavior. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 列鎖、predicate、wait原子解鎖、signal、重新取鎖的事件；將if版本與while版本放入同一排程。
related.differenceEn: Trace lock, predicate, wait’s atomic unlock, signal and reacquisition, placing if and while variants in one schedule.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
一般訊號的pending狀態不等於可靠事件計數；遮罩期間同類訊號可合併。處理器中只使用規範允許的非同步安全操作。
本課數值核對：min(5,1) = 1 events；另一項核對：5-1 = 4 events。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

條件變數等待必須在互斥鎖保護下反覆檢查predicate；喚醒是重新檢查的機會，不是資源保證。
本課數值核對：6-2 = 4 items；另一項核對：1-1 = 0 items。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
A pending ordinary signal is not a reliable event counter; repeated blocked signals may coalesce. A handler uses only specified async-signal-safe operations.
Numeric audit: min(5,1) = 1 events; second audit: 5-1 = 4 events. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Condition waits recheck a predicate in a loop under its mutex; waking is an opportunity to recheck, not a resource grant.
Numeric audit: 6-2 = 4 items; second audit: 1-1 = 0 items. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Linux 回收：LRU 工作集合與抖動
related.titleEn: Linux reclaim: LRU working sets and thrashing
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付兩種事件模型及不安全handler操作的替代方案；不宣稱此教學器重現所有OS排程。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver both event models and alternatives to unsafe handler work; do not claim to reproduce every OS scheduling behavior. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 逐筆列存取前後MRU→LRU順序、hit/miss與eviction，不只統計總和。
related.differenceEn: Record before/after MRU-to-LRU order, hit/miss and eviction for every access instead of only totals.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
一般訊號的pending狀態不等於可靠事件計數；遮罩期間同類訊號可合併。處理器中只使用規範允許的非同步安全操作。
本課數值核對：min(5,1) = 1 events；另一項核對：5-1 = 4 events。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

以精確LRU教學器研究局部性；Linux多世代LRU不是此簡化隊列。工作集合超過容量時可能持續缺頁。
本課數值核對：9/9 = 1 miss_ratio；另一項核對：3/9 = 0.333333333333 miss_ratio。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
A pending ordinary signal is not a reliable event counter; repeated blocked signals may coalesce. A handler uses only specified async-signal-safe operations.
Numeric audit: min(5,1) = 1 events; second audit: 5-1 = 4 events. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Study locality with an exact-LRU teaching model; Linux multigenerational LRU is not this simple queue. A working set larger than capacity can repeatedly miss.
Numeric audit: 9/9 = 1 miss_ratio; second audit: 3/9 = 0.333333333333 miss_ratio. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
